home.title: Living documentation that lives with your code
home.subtitle: LivingDocs connects your codebase to its documentation: every workspace's purpose, drift detection, review queues, and AI-assisted generation — all in one place.
home.feature1Body: Drift detection runs whenever your code changes, surfacing what needs review.
home.feature2Body: Templates guide the AI so generated docs follow your team's conventions.
home.feature3Body: Group related services and share templates, knowledge, and reviews across them.
home.reviewBody: Every change goes through a human-in-the-loop checkpoint. AI drafts are suggestions, not commits.
home.healthBody: Freshness, coverage, drift and confidence scores roll up into one dashboard per workspace.
home.lead: LivingDocs keeps the docs next to the pull request. Generate drafts from code, route them through human review, surface drift before it ships.
home.whatYouGetSubtitle: The four jobs LivingDocs is built for, in one tool.
home.readyTitle: Ready to give your docs a pulse?
home.readyBody: Spin up a workspace, connect a GitHub repo, and let the AI service draft your first document in under two minutes.

about.hero: LivingDocs keeps your documentation next to your code — automatically generated, AI-assisted, and always in sync with your repository.
about.githubDesc: Your source code lives here. LivingDocs listens to pushes and pull requests to detect drift and trigger documentation updates.
about.backendDesc: Spring Boot API manages documents, versions, templates, drift alerts, and workspace membership. Persists everything to PostgreSQL.
